title: Adopt landed-changed/ entries: roles stop editing CHANGELOG.md
lead: *Proposed.* Drafted 2026-11-11. ork's side of slicer s453. Once slicer can write and assemble per-item entries under `landed-changed/`, ork's role prompts, docs and checks tell the implementer to write its entry with slicer's command and never edit `CHANGELOG.md`. ork's existing `## Unreleased` entries are converted into `landed-changed/` files. The owner decided on 2026-11-11: slicer owns the format and the assembly, the folder is named `landed-changed`, and converting the existing entries is allowed.
findings_note: Owner 2026-11-11: per-slice changelog files in landed-changed/, owned and assembled by slicer (slicer s453); convert the existing Unreleased entries. Depends on slicer s453 landing.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
*Proposed.* Evidence:

- CHANGELOG.md conflicted at landing on S132, S173, S204, S223, S226, S244, S255, S257, S263 and S267 (2026-11-08 to 11-11), because every slice adds a bullet at the top of `## Unreleased`. S327 makes ork's resolver handle the file's mixed layout (adj 276). That is a patch; separate files remove the conflict.
- The slice specs end with a "CHANGELOG.md: one bullet under `## Unreleased`" step, and the implementer prompt and AGENTS.md carry the same rule. They change once slicer's command exists.
- The CHANGELOG resolver (`internal/engine/changelog.go`, `internal/engine/landmerge.go:92-98`) becomes a fallback for projects that have not adopted `landed-changed/`. Whether to keep it is Q2.

Blocked on slicer s453 (open in slicer's store, needs-owner). The command names below are placeholders until s453 is decided.

Open owner questions (the owner answers before the relay starts):
- Q1 when to convert ork's existing Unreleased entries. (a) in this slice, with slicer's import command, in one commit (recommended). (b) at the v1.2 release step.
- Q2 the CHANGELOG resolver. (a) keep it for projects without `landed-changed/` (recommended: ork runs other projects). (b) remove it.
- Q3 does the gate check the entry. (a) yes: the gate fails a slice whose item has no `landed-changed/ID.md` when the project uses the folder (recommended). (b) no, slicer check covers it.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - Written after s453 and Q1 to Q3. At least: the implementer prompt names slicer's entry command and no longer tells the role to edit `CHANGELOG.md` (prompt golden test), and under Q3 (a) a gate brief names the missing entry.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Wait for slicer s453 to land and for Q1 to Q3. Then write the steps for the chosen options.
